certification.name: Certified Ethical Hacker (Practical)
certification.description: Six-hour proctored practical exam of 20 challenges on the iLabs Cyber Range, with a passing score of 60% to 85% depending on the exam form. No eligibility criteria; passing it in addition to the CEH knowledge exam gives CEH Master.
certification.currency_note: Exam dashboard code with remote proctoring, valid one year from receipt
